summary: Added node status badges and deployed_version column. Updated get_nodes() to fetch deployed_version and truncate to 8 chars. Rewrote nodes.html with color-coded text badges (active→green, draining→yellow, restarting→orange, error→red) and a Version column. Added badge-green/yellow/orange/red CSS classes. Updated NODE_REQUIRED_COLUMNS in test_queries.py, sample_nodes fixture in conftest.py, and added badge/version tests in test_templates.py. All 35 template tests pass.
